summary: Nuvve Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its special meeting of stockholders on June 15, 2026, lacked a quorum and was adjourned to June 23, 2026. The meeting was to vote on proposals from a proxy statement filed May 29, 2026. The adjournment is a procedural step to solicit additional proxies. No special situation such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine current report about a meeting adjournment.
